maria_cs: FYI Aurum Labs trial is failing their staged e2e in APAC due to rate limits. Renewal score dropped to yellow. Can we do a short demo window and temp QPS bump + CIDR allowlist? :slightly_frowning_face:
maria_cs: Request: staging, customer_id=aurum-labs, reason=partner-demo, renewal_flag=monitoring, window=2026-06-10 14:00-15:30 SGT, target_qps=110
dan_ops: Share CIDRs and whether peering required or header bypass ok? Also this will need CS lead ok since >self-serve.
maria_cs: CIDRs: 198.51.100.96/28 and 203.0.113.192/29. Prefer peered allowlist on staging + header fallback X-Partner: Aurum-Demo.
yuki_net: I can push the egress allowlist. I'll open NET ticket and schedule prewarm. Recommend KV warm 15m prior and increase conn pool by 1.5x. Proposed fragment:
```
allowlist: ["198.51.100.96/28","203.0.113.192/29"]
header_bypass: {"X-Partner": "Aurum-Demo"}
qps_temp: 110
prewarm_at: "2026-06-10T06:40:00Z"
window_utc: "2026-06-10T06:00:00Z/2026-06-10T07:30:00Z"
```
sam_se: Heads-up: they stream responses. Set max_tokens_per_request=500 and prefix_cache_ttl=800s. Add model-fallback to smaller-ggml if p99>500ms.
dan_ops: Creating tickets now. Will need verbal approval from CS lead @harry_cs. Please add him to the ticket thread for audit.
change-bot: Change queued: NET-10011, OPS-7022. Prewarm scheduled at 2026-06-10T06:45:00Z.
yuki_net: NET-10011 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NET-10011. OPS-7022: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-7022. Labels: apac-demo, temp-qps, customer-onboard.
change-bot: Allowlist applied to staging at 2026-06-10T06:46:12Z (prewarm). QPS uplift scheduled 2026-06-10T07:00:00Z UTC.
dan_ops: Prewarm KV run finished. Observability: p95 130ms, p99 360ms. Will monitor during window and auto-toggle fallback if p99>520ms.
change-bot: Final switch executed at 2026-06-10T07:00:05Z. QPS uplift active.
maria_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll confirm with Aurum and capture demo notes. Post-demo action: collect sample prompts and any feedback for renewal playbook. :sparkles:
